results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: List projects using TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS (capture project_id for grouping and downstream queries).
[Optional (if you need to restrict to a subset of projects)] [Prerequisite]: Find matching projects using TODOIST_SEARCH_PROJECTS (resolve project_id before project-scoped pulls).
[Optional (if you need section grouping)] [Step]: List sections using TODOIST_LIST_SECTIONS (optionally scoped by project_id; map section_id→project_id for joins).
[Required] [Step]: List active tasks using TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS (paginate via cursor/next_cursor; validate each task’s project_id when scoping; join to projects/sections by IDs).
[Required] [Step]: List completed tasks using TODOIST_LIST_COMPLETED_TASKS (optionally by project_id; paginate via cursor/next_cursor; parse completed items from completed-task shape).
[Optional (for focused views or QA)] [Next Step]: Refine the active task set using TODOIST_FILTER_TASKS (apply query; re-join to projects/sections).
[Optional (if you need richer per-project context)] [Next Step]: Enrich a project snapshot using TODOIST_GET_PROJECT_FULL (reduce joins when building the final output).

[Optional (if completed history is too large or you only need a window)] [Fallback]: Fetch completions using TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE (since/until in desired timezone; paginate via cursor/next_cursor until empty).
known_pitfalls: [TODOIST_LIST_SECTIONS] Sections are returned under response.data.results (not a top-level array).
[TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS] Returns only active/incomplete tasks; completion history must come from TODOIST_LIST_COMPLETED_TASKS or TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE.
[TODOIST_LIST_COMPLETED_TASKS] Completed-task payload commonly uses data.items (different from active task shapes) and can be very large; scope by project_id when possible.
[TODOIST_FILTER_TASKS] Active tasks are returned under data.results (not data.tasks), so downstream parsing must branch by tool response shape.
[TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE] Results are under response.data.items and may be empty for a window even when pagination fields are present.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse a combined tool payload to summarize how many active tasks exist per project_id.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json,collections
payload=json.loads(s)
projects=payload["results"][0]["response"]["data"]["projects"]
tasks=payload["results"][1]["response"]["data"]["tasks"]
counts=collections.Counter(t.get("project_id") for t in tasks)
print({"project_count":len(projects),"active_task_counts_by_project_id":dict(counts)})
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Extract active/completed/section lists defensively when response shapes differ or keys are nested.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
p=json.loads(s)
sec=p["results"][0]["response"]["data"].get("results") or []
active=p["results"][1]["response"]["data"].get("tasks") or []
completed=p["results"][2]["response"]["data"].get("items") or []
print({"sections":len(sec),"active":len(active),"completed":len(completed)})
```

TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS.description: Get all projects from a user's Todoist account. Retrieves all active (non-archived) projects; use TODOIST_LIST_ARCHIVED_WORKSPACE_PROJECTS for archived ones. Response returns the list in the projects field, with fields including project_id, name, color, parent project, sharing status, and is_inbox_project flag. Always reference projects by project_id — names are non-unique and may be localized. Detect the Inbox via is_inbox_project, not by name. Results are a point-in-time snapshot; re-call after structural changes before relying on cached project_ids. In large accounts, paginate until no next-page token remains to avoid missing projects. Check existing projects before creating new ones to prevent duplicates.

limit.description: The number of projects to return per page. Defaults to server default if not provided.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. Use the next_cursor value to fetch the next page of results.

TODOIST_LIST_SECTIONS.description: Tool to get all active sections for the user, with optional filtering by project. Supports cursor-based pagination to handle large result sets.

limit.description: The number of objects to return in a page. Default is 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results. Use the next_cursor value from a previous response.

project_id.description: String ID of the project to get sections from. If omitted or null, get sections from all projects.

TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS.description: Fetches all INCOMPLETE tasks from Todoist and returns their details. Supports cursor-based pagination. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - This endpoint only returns active (incomplete) tasks - Cannot retrieve completed tasks - use a different endpoint for that - Filter queries using 'completed', '!completed', or 'completed after' will fail - Project/label references must use ACTUAL EXISTING names from the user's account - Arbitrary text in filters causes 400 errors - use 'search: keyword' for text search Common use cases: - Get all tasks: no filter - Get today's tasks: filter="today" - Get overdue tasks: filter="overdue" - Get tasks from specific project: filter="#ProjectName" (project must exist) - Get high priority tasks: filter="p1" - Search task content: filter="search: keyword" - Paginate results: use limit and cursor parameters

ids.description: List of task IDs to retrieve (alphanumeric string IDs).

lang.description: Language code for parsing date/times in queries.

limit.description: The number of tasks to return per page. Default is 50.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the next_cursor value from previous response to get next page.

filter.description: Filter tasks using Todoist filter syntax. This endpoint only returns INCOMPLETE tasks. Terms must be valid keywords or reference existing entities; arbitrary text causes 400 errors. Supported filters: predefined keywords ('today', 'overdue', 'no due date', etc.), priority ('p1'-'p4'), projects ('#Name'), labels ('@Name'), relative dates ('7 days', '-7 days'), date filters ('due before: YYYY-MM-DD'), created/deadline ('created after: -14 days'), search ('search: keyword'). Operators: '&' (AND), '|' (OR), '!' (NOT). DO NOT USE: 'completed', '!completed', 'completed after' - these cause 400 errors on this endpoint (use TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETION_DATE instead).

TODOIST_LIST_COMPLETED_TASKS.description: Tool to retrieve all completed tasks with optional project filtering. Use when you need to fetch completed tasks without date range restrictions. Note: This action uses an undocumented Todoist API endpoint (/api/v1/tasks/completed). The endpoint is not officially documented but is confirmed to work based on runtime testing. The response schemas are based on actual API responses.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return per page. Optional parameter.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response to fetch next page of results. Optional parameter.

project_id.description: Filter completed tasks by project ID. Optional parameter.

TODOIST_GET_COMPLETED_TASKS_BY_COMPLETIO.description: Tool to retrieve completed tasks within a specified completion date window. Use when you need to fetch historical completed tasks for reporting, audits, or weekly summaries. The API restricts the completion-date range to approximately 3 months between since and until parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return per page. Optional parameter. API default is 50.

since.description: Start date for filtering completed tasks in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Must be before 'until'. Maximum range between 'since' and 'until' is 3 months (~92 days).

until.description: End date for filtering completed tasks in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-31T23:59:59Z'). Must be after 'since'. Maximum range between 'since' and 'until' is 3 months (~92 days).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response to fetch next page of results. Optional parameter.

parent_id.description: Parent task ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fr9mHQJG3HV7gC4') to filter completed subtasks. Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_TASKS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

project_id.description: Project ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fm7pCWp5Q3hhwHW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

section_id.description: Section ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6fm7pCWp5Q3hhwHW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_SECTIONS. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.

filter_lang.description: Language code for parsing filter_query. Optional parameter.

filter_query.description: Filter query string using Todoist's filter syntax to further refine results. Optional parameter.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID in v2 alphanumeric format (e.g., '6XvwwRvRfmCjM5PW'). Use IDs from TODOIST_GET_ALL_PROJECTS or similar actions. Numeric v1 IDs are deprecated.
